extDescription.message: Read local Markdown and text notes, read-only: Wiki Links, callouts, diagrams, math and search. Files never leave your device.

optionsIntro.message: Parchment opens your local Markdown and text files read-only. Everything is processed in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

autoOpenHeading.message: Open local Markdown files with Parchment

autoOpenLabel.message: When I open a local .md file in the browser, show it in Parchment

autoOpenHelp.message: Relative images and links to other .md files in the same folder keep working. Press Back to see the original plain text.

fileAccessEnabled.message: Enabled. Local .md files will open in Parchment.

fileAccessDisabled.message: Not enabled. To open local .md files with Parchment, turn on "Allow access to file URLs" in the extension's details page.

fileAccessNote.message: The browser requires you to turn this on yourself. Opening files and folders from inside Parchment works without it.

privacyNote.message: Parchment does not collect, send or store your documents anywhere outside this browser. It only reads the files you open.
